context: Tests whether the agent uses the A2A client to consume the remote agent (the right protocol for agent-to-agent calls) and wraps it as a tool so the local LLM can choose delegation per query — matching the developer's stated 'LLM decides' preference.

checklist.name: Uses A2AClient to call the remote
checklist.description: Builds an A2AClient targeting the analyst endpoint and uses it to invoke the remote. Does NOT use MCP (wrong protocol — MCP is for tool hosts, A2A is for full agents) and does NOT call the remote HTTP endpoint with a raw HTTP client

checklist.name: Adds a2a-core and a2a-client dependencies
checklist.description: Adds both ai.koog:a2a-core and ai.koog:a2a-client at 1.3.0-beta to build.gradle.kts. Does not add a2a-server (wrong direction — this is consume, not serve)

checklist.name: Wraps the A2A call inside a tool
checklist.description: Exposes the A2A call to the local LLM as a tool — e.g., a @Tool-annotated method that calls client.run(...). The LLM picks when to delegate; the wrapping makes the remote appear as a regular tool

checklist.name: Reads the bearer token from the environment
checklist.description: Reads ANALYST_API_TOKEN from System.getenv and passes it to the A2A client's auth configuration. Does not embed the token literal

checklist.name: Registers the wrapper tool with the agent
checklist.description: Adds the tool (or its ToolSet) into the local agent's ToolRegistry via the standard registry DSL. Does not mutate the registry after construction
